content:
Stay curious. ✨

You don’t know everything, and you won’t always be right — and that’s okay.

Growth begins when we stay open to learning, questioning what we believe, and being willing to see things from a different perspective.

The more curious we become, the more we discover.
The more we learn, the more we realize how much there is still to learn.

You don’t need to have all the answers.
Sometimes, the most powerful thing you can do is simply ask, “What else can I learn from this?”

Stay curious.
Stay humble.
Keep learning. 🚀

comment: Curiosity is most valuable when it challenges our assumptions. In practice, the hardest questions are often the ones we avoid asking because they expose gaps in our own thinking.
